claim: click.edit treats a single pathlib.Path filename as one file path.
ground_truth_evidence: edit checks for both str and os.PathLike before deciding whether to wrap filename in a one-item tuple.
task_description: Review Click edit filename handling after commit a1d8785.

claim: click.edit treats a pathlib.Path filename as a generic iterable of path components.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated type check recognizes os.PathLike and wraps the Path object as a single filename.
task_description: Review Click edit filename handling after commit a1d8785.

claim: _tempfilepager forwards parsed PAGER command parameters to subprocess.call.
ground_truth_evidence: The subprocess argument list is [str(cmd_path), *cmd_params, f.name].
task_description: Review Click temporary pager invocation after commit a6256bf.

claim: _tempfilepager invokes the pager executable with only the temporary filename.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated subprocess call inserts cmd_params before the temporary filename.
task_description: Review Click temporary pager invocation after commit a6256bf.

claim: _tempfilepager closes the temporary file before unlinking it.
ground_truth_evidence: The finally block calls f.close() and then os.unlink(f.name).
task_description: Review Click temporary pager cleanup after commit 1f9cd54.

claim: _tempfilepager unlinks the temporary file while it is still open.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated cleanup explicitly closes f before calling os.unlink.
task_description: Review Click temporary pager cleanup after commit 1f9cd54.

claim: get_help_option_names preserves the declaration order of help option names.
ground_truth_evidence: The implementation uses dict.fromkeys and pop, whose iteration order follows declaration order.
task_description: Review Click help-option selection after commit 047adef.

claim: get_help_option_names still converts help option names to an unordered set.
ground_truth_evidence: The set-based implementation was replaced by an insertion-ordered dict.
task_description: Review Click help-option selection after commit 047adef.

claim: Click's ANSI matcher accepts parameter bytes, intermediate bytes, and a final byte in the ECMA-48 ranges.
ground_truth_evidence: _ansi_re is compiled from the pattern \033\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~].
task_description: Review Click ANSI stripping after commit 71f2baf.

claim: Click's ANSI matcher only recognizes numeric parameters separated by semicolons.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated regex uses the broader ECMA-48 byte ranges rather than the older numeric-only form.
task_description: Review Click ANSI stripping after commit 71f2baf.

claim: HookCaller._remove_plugin removes every hook implementation registered by the plugin.
ground_truth_evidence: It filters _hookimpls and replaces the list with all entries whose plugin differs.
task_description: Review pluggy hook implementation removal after commit 20d8143.

claim: HookCaller._remove_plugin returns after deleting the first matching hook implementation.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated implementation performs a full list filter and has no early return after one match.
task_description: Review pluggy hook implementation removal after commit 20d8143.

claim: varnames emits a FutureWarning for a class-like method missing self when legacy_noself is enabled.
ground_truth_evidence: The legacy_noself branch calls warnings.warn with FutureWarning when the first argument is not an implicit name.
task_description: Review pluggy legacy hookspec method handling after commit dd20a85.

claim: varnames silently accepts a legacy hookspec method missing self.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated legacy_noself branch warns instead of silently accepting that shape.
task_description: Review pluggy legacy hookspec method handling after commit dd20a85.

claim: list_plugin_distinfo wraps stored distributions with DistFacade before returning them.
ground_truth_evidence: The method returns a comprehension containing DistFacade(dist) for each stored distribution.
task_description: Review pluggy distribution listing after commit 53eeddf.

claim: list_plugin_distinfo returns the raw importlib.metadata distributions stored by the manager.
ground_truth_evidence: Raw distributions are returned by list_plugin_distributions; list_plugin_distinfo applies DistFacade.
task_description: Review pluggy distribution listing after commit 53eeddf.

claim: varnames can strip an implicit self argument from a bound method even when its qualname has no dot.
ground_truth_evidence: It records inspect.ismethod(func) in is_bound before unwrapping and uses is_bound in the stripping condition.
task_description: Review pluggy bound-method argument discovery after commit 0b7790e.

claim: varnames relies only on a dot in __qualname__ to strip a bound method's self argument.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated condition also uses the separately captured is_bound flag.
task_description: Review pluggy bound-method argument discovery after commit 0b7790e.

claim: varnames derives positional parameter names directly from the callable's code object.
ground_truth_evidence: It reads func.__code__.co_varnames up to co_argcount and partitions defaults.
task_description: Review pluggy parameter discovery after commit c4e254c.

claim: varnames still calls inspect.signature to discover positional parameters.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated implementation reads __code__ and __defaults__ instead of inspect.signature.
task_description: Review pluggy parameter discovery after commit c4e254c.

claim: attrs.fields accepts an attrs instance and introspects its type.
ground_truth_evidence: For a non-type whose type has __attrs_attrs__, fields returns fields(type_).
task_description: Review attrs.fields input handling after commit 48b8611.

claim: attrs.fields rejects every non-class input with TypeError.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated implementation accepts non-class inputs when their type is an attrs class.
task_description: Review attrs.fields input handling after commit 48b8611.

claim: attrs raises RuntimeError when a generator on_setattr hook yields more than once.
ground_truth_evidence: After assigning the first yielded value, __setattr__ advances again, closes the generator, and raises RuntimeError if it yields.
task_description: Review attrs generator on_setattr hooks after commit 4b5b295.

claim: attrs accepts every value yielded by a generator on_setattr hook without limiting the number of yields.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated implementation explicitly rejects a second yield.
task_description: Review attrs generator on_setattr hooks after commit 4b5b295.

claim: attrs.validators.ne constructs _NumberValidator with operator.ne.
ground_truth_evidence: ne returns _NumberValidator(val, '!=', operator.ne).
task_description: Review the attrs ne validator after commit 5aa76a4.

claim: attrs.validators.ne delegates comparison to operator.eq.
ground_truth_evidence: The new validator passes operator.ne, not operator.eq.
task_description: Review the attrs ne validator after commit 5aa76a4.

claim: _ClassBuilder.add_replace attaches generated method dunders to a local __replace__ proxy.
ground_truth_evidence: add_replace defines a local proxy around evolve and passes that proxy to _add_method_dunders.
task_description: Review attrs __replace__ generation after commit f53fc54.

claim: _ClassBuilder.add_replace attaches generated method dunders directly to the global evolve function.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated implementation passes the local __replace__ proxy rather than evolve itself.
task_description: Review attrs __replace__ generation after commit f53fc54.

claim: _is_class_var unwraps an annotation's __forward_arg__ before converting it to text.
ground_truth_evidence: The first assignment replaces annot with getattr(annot, '__forward_arg__', annot).
task_description: Review attrs ClassVar forward-reference detection after commit 97f8d17.

claim: _is_class_var immediately converts the annotation object itself to text.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated code first extracts __forward_arg__ when present.
task_description: Review attrs ClassVar forward-reference detection after commit 97f8d17.

claim: Two one-element numeric_range objects can be equal even when their step values differ.
ground_truth_evidence: After confirming equal length and start, __eq__ returns True immediately when length is one.
task_description: Review numeric_range equality after commit 069b300.

claim: numeric_range equality always requires equal step values for nonempty ranges.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated length-one branch returns True without comparing steps.
task_description: Review numeric_range equality after commit 069b300.

claim: chunked raises ValueError when n is a negative integer.
ground_truth_evidence: The function begins with a guard for n is not None and n < 0.
task_description: Review more-itertools chunked validation after commit 0e6acdf.

claim: chunked has no explicit guard against a negative n.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated implementation checks for negative n before creating its iterator.
task_description: Review more-itertools chunked validation after commit 0e6acdf.

claim: nth_permutation computes its index digits without calling math.factorial.
ground_truth_evidence: The factorial import and factorial-based q expression were removed; q starts as index.
task_description: Review nth_permutation index calculation after commit 237388c.

claim: nth_permutation still calls factorial(n) when r is smaller than n.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated code no longer imports or calls factorial.
task_description: Review nth_permutation index calculation after commit 237388c.

claim: _windowed_running_min keeps an earlier value when a later value compares equal.
ground_truth_evidence: Its pruning loop retains the prior tail while tail_value <= value, preserving the earlier equal value.
task_description: Review running_min stability after commit d992be0.

claim: _windowed_running_min discards the earlier value whenever a later value compares equal.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated <= condition stops pruning on equality.
task_description: Review running_min stability after commit d992be0.

claim: sliced raises ValueError for a negative slice size.
ground_truth_evidence: The function now starts with if n < 0: raise ValueError.
task_description: Review more-itertools sliced validation after commit 958990e.

claim: sliced still passes a negative slice size directly into count.
ground_truth_evidence: The new negative-size guard runs before the count-based iterator is created.
task_description: Review more-itertools sliced validation after commit 958990e.

claim: HTTPAdapter.request_url preserves multiple leading slashes in request.path_url for a direct request.
ground_truth_evidence: request_url initializes url from request.path_url and no longer collapses a leading double slash.
task_description: Review Requests adapter path handling after commit fd62809.

claim: HTTPAdapter.request_url collapses multiple leading slashes in request.path_url to one slash.
ground_truth_evidence: The slash-collapsing block was removed from the updated implementation.
task_description: Review Requests adapter path handling after commit fd62809.

claim: _parse_content_type_header ignores a nonempty parameter token that contains no equals sign.
ground_truth_evidence: The loop only adds a parameter when param is nonempty and param.find('=') is not -1.
task_description: Review Requests Content-Type parsing after commit f0198e6.

claim: _parse_content_type_header stores a parameter without an equals sign with the value True.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated condition excludes malformed tokens instead of assigning True.
task_description: Review Requests Content-Type parsing after commit f0198e6.

claim: _encode_files calls read on a file wrapper when hasattr(wrapper, 'read') is true.
ground_truth_evidence: The read branch accepts either _SupportsRead instances or objects for which hasattr(fp, 'read') succeeds.
task_description: Review Requests multipart file-wrapper handling after commit 6f205ff.

claim: _encode_files calls read only when the wrapper passes the _SupportsRead isinstance check.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated branch includes an alternative hasattr(fp, 'read') check.
task_description: Review Requests multipart file-wrapper handling after commit 6f205ff.

claim: resolve_redirects copies prior history into resp.history before appending resp to the local history list.
ground_truth_evidence: Inside the loop, resp.history = hist[:] occurs immediately before hist.append(resp).
task_description: Review Requests redirect history construction after commit ef439eb.

claim: resolve_redirects appends resp before copying history into resp.history.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated order assigns the copy first, preventing resp from appearing in its own history.
task_description: Review Requests redirect history construction after commit ef439eb.

claim: prepare_body treats data as iterable when isinstance(data, Iterable) or hasattr(data, '__iter__') succeeds.
ground_truth_evidence: The is_iterable variable combines the protocol isinstance check with an __iter__ attribute check.
task_description: Review Requests request-body stream detection after commit 6404f34.

claim: prepare_body still relies exclusively on isinstance(data, Iterable) to detect streams.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated implementation adds hasattr(data, '__iter__') as an alternative.
task_description: Review Requests request-body stream detection after commit 6404f34.
